replaces_current_proposal: CMP-1; preserved in parent Git commit and original custody

authority.exhausted_budget_rule: The original allowance cannot fund new work. New review/pilot units require explicit separate linked authority; no reset/refund/implicit approval.

separate_requests.scope: Independent read-only review of final VPR-2 policy/allocation audit/stages, no implementation/evaluation execution

authority.executed_count_scope: No additional agent/reviewer/pilot task-slot generation dispatched. Current root authoring is explicitly requested; its provider usage is unmeasured and not claimed zero.

stages.gap: Initial small prompt-edit and independent-review dispatch/usage/time/operator measurements
stages.method: Existing hosted task/subagent interface; fresh prompt contexts with no inherited author conversation; text in/text out; no local native client, tools, skill execution or new authentication
stages.availability_evidence: Current session exposes task dispatch, fresh-context and text-return capabilities; no model call made to verify execution. Budget approval remains required.

nodes.requires: Authentic A1 response/partial/failure record and a separate fresh review context

stages.proves_only: Observed costs and task/review workload occurrence; no native isolation or validation claim
current_dependencies: Existing task interface still available; otherwise stop
Raw bounded role packets and no undisclosed author history in reviewer
stages.deadline_rule: 600 seconds per task from dispatch through terminal settlement; interrupt unfinished tasks, retain charge/censored result; no pause/reset.

dispatch_interface.execution_rule: After explicit funding only; one initial call per task. No followup_task/resume/child delegation. A2 receives exact A1 output plus raw task/criteria, no parent conversation.
dispatch_interface.root_parallel_work: Prepare/capture timestamp, identity and usage/operator records while each task runs; no extra model work.
dispatch_interface.availability_limit: If this tool is not available at execution time, report unavailable and retain the proposed allocation; do not switch methods silently.

stages.gap: Installed native utility/resource, pair-output or native usage-capture cost absent from A and needed by a selected validation plan
requires: Exact installed identities and supported actual native boundary

stages.gap: Operator-answer and continuation cost remains needed and unmeasured after earlier selected stages
requires: Existing original parent deadline; no reset

stages.gap: Real inner review, parent return/resumption and report grading cost remains needed and unmeasured
requires: Supported independently checked nested review and counted return
Actual matching raw child evidence and safe parent

accounting.external_generations: Count actual initial dispatches and continuations separately, retaining failed/censored charges and authentic nonlaunch status.
accounting.internal_requests: Only observable actual requests/retries/compaction with source/scope; otherwise NOT_OBSERVABLE.
accounting.cached_input_rule: May be a subset of input; preserve provider meaning and do not double count.
accounting.cumulative_rule: Do not add session totals to their constituent turn deltas.
accounting.deterministic_execution: Separate count, duration, exit and purpose; model calls behind commands remain model work.
accounting.operator: Active per-person intervals separated from waiting; authentication/answers/review/closeout included.
accounting.elapsed: Actual wall interval union through closeout; do not sum overlapping parent/child or operator/model spans.
accounting.clock: UTC plus monotonic where observable; disclose resolution/source. No paused/restarted parent cutoff.
accounting.unknown: NOT_OBSERVABLE with cause; never zero or inferred consumption.
accounting.subscription_limit: Dispatch counts and time ceilings are not reliable consumption estimates; no conversion without actual provider-defined measurements.
accounting.root_authoring_usage: NOT_OBSERVABLE in this record; do not infer zero consumption from zero added task-slot dispatches.

authentication.separate_from: Evidence context, writable workspace, history/memory and review independence
authentication.stage_A: Existing authenticated host task service; zero new login/profile actions planned; no credential or ordinary global state access
authentication.native_reuse_status: Cached login/refresh and credential-store primitives documented; exact isolated native combination and cross-root behavior unresolved
authentication.sensitivity_status: Unmeasured planning assumptions only; actual burden determines practicality.

output_record: Use existing plan/result + ordinary raw transcript/custody files; machine-generate metric joins/identities; no extra approval artifact per metric.
forbidden_claims: Native isolation established by fresh prompt context
Measured subscription consumption inferred from attempt/time bounds
